works.title: Red Dead Redemption Complete Saga: Interdisciplinary Academic Research
works.abstract:
This project provides an exhaustive, peer-reviewed academic monograph examining *Red Dead Redemption 2* (2018) and *Red Dead Redemption* (2010) as a single continuous chronological saga spanning 1899 to 1914. Tracing the tragic trajectory from Arthur Morgan's moral reawakening amidst terminal illness to John Marston's state-coerced destruction and Jack Marston's climactic embrace of the outlaw cycle in 1914, the study interrogates how interactive game architecture, moral mechanics, and historical world-building dissect the death of the American frontier and the myth of individual redemption.

works.title: Battlefield V (2018) — War Stories Campaign Academic Research Project
works.abstract:
This repository hosts a comprehensive, interdisciplinary academic research paper and critical game studies investigation into the single-player campaign of *Battlefield V* (DICE/Electronic Arts, 2018).

The campaign comprises:
1. **Prologue:** *My Country Calling* (London 1939, Narvik 1940, Tobruk 1941, Kasserine Pass 1942, Hamburg 1943, Nijmegen Bridge 1944)
2. **War Story One:** *Under No Flag* (North Africa, 1942; Billy Bridger, George Mason, British Special Boat Section)
3. **War Story Two:** *Nordlys* (Occupied Norway, 1943; Solveig Fia Bjørnstad, Astrid Bjørnstad, heavy water sabotage)
4. **War Story Three:** *Tirailleur* (Southern France, 1944; Deme Cissé, Idrissa, Senegalese Tirailleurs, Operation Dragoon)
5. **War Story Four:** *The Last Tiger* (Ruhr/Rhine, Germany, 1945; Peter Müller, Kertz, Hartmann, Schröder, Tiger 237)
